description: Select — dropdown selector built on Radix Select (ADR-001 Radix convention). Radix owns the listbox a11y contract: managed focus + active-descendant, typeahead, full keyboard (Home/End/PageUp-Down/wrap), Popper collision/flip positioning, and dismissal. The HDS surface is styled with the token-backed Tailwind idiom used by tabs.tsx / command-palette.tsx; `ref` targets the trigger button.

usage.when: Choose one value from a short list of options in a form field.
usage.whenNot: Firing actions, or choosing from a list long enough to need search.

useInstead.reason: a long list that needs search
